mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_attempt (outbox_id, cycle_no, attempt_no, claim_token, worker_id, started_at, outcome) VALUES (#{outboxId}, #{cycleNo}, #{attemptNo}, #{claimToken}::uuid, #{workerId}, now(), 'STARTED')

INSERT INTO delivery_attempt (outbox_id, cycle_no, attempt_no, claim_token, worker_id, started_at, finished_at, outcome) VALUES (#{outboxId}, #{cycleNo}, #{attemptNo}, #{claimToken}::uuid, #{workerId}, now(), now(), 'SKIPPED_MAX_ATTEMPTS')
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_attempt SET late_outcome = #{lateOutcome} WHERE claim_token = #{claimToken}::uuid AND outcome = 'ABANDONED' AND late_outcome IS NULL
